task_name: World 136 Task A  -  Prepaid Rollforward, ASC 350-40 Cloud Implementation Split, Draft Rejection & Disclosed vs Undisclosed Unscheduled Carryforward
prompt: Review the QuickBooks Online chart of accounts, 1350 prepaid and vendor-advance schedule, vendor contracts and invoices, prior-bookkeeper draft and disclosure table (including close_disclosed_items across prior and current snapshots), and posted October 2026 QuickBooks Online general ledger for Northstar Logistics & Cold-Chain Inc. in northstar_coldchain_oct2026_prepaids_and_asc350_cca.xlsx. Build the schedule-backed October 2026 rollforward for the commercial GL and cyber insurance policies, the Arctic Rack Systems equipment advance, and the CloudCold WMS cloud computing arrangement under ASC 350-40 (separating hosted SaaS subscription, application-development configuration, and data migration/training), evaluate the junior bookkeeper's unposted insurance draft, and determine exact October 31, 2026 ending balances for scheduled 1350, unscheduled 1350 (distinguishing the disclosed slice from the undisclosed slice), and 1370.

rubric.description: Computes October 2026 insurance amortization from 1350 as $3,000.00 on POL-2026-GL ($27,000.00 carrying -> $24,000.00 ending) and $1,500.00 on POL-2026-CYBER ($18,000.00 paid Oct 1 -> $16,500.00 ending), totaling $4,500.00 Dr 6310 Insurance Expense / Cr 1350.

Rejects unposted junior draft DRAFT-JE-409 ($4,500.00 crediting 2190 Accrued Expenses with $0.00 prior liability instead of 1350), explaining that both policies were already paid upfront into 1350 and crediting/releasing 2190 would leave 1350 overstated and distort 2190.

Retains the $12,000.00 Arctic Rack Systems wire advance (BILL-PMT-712, 0% delivered in October 2026) in 1350 at $12,000.00 ($0.00 October P&L expense) under a provisional_with_true_up trigger upon December 2026 racking delivery and installation.

Splits CloudCold WMS arrangement INV-WMS-901 ($54,000.00) under ASC 350-40 into (1) $18,000.00 Year-1 hosted SaaS subscription ($1,500.00 Oct amortization, $16,500.00 ending in 1350), (2) $24,000.00 capitalizable application-development configuration reclassified to 1370 and amortized over the 36-month hosted term ($666.67 Oct amortization, $23,333.33 ending net 1370), and (3) $12,000.00 non-capitalizable data migration ($7,200.00) and training ($4,800.00) expensed 100% in October 2026.

Computes the October 31, 2026 scheduled active carrying balance in 1350 as $69,000.00 ($24,000.00 POL-2026-GL + $16,500.00 POL-2026-CYBER + $12,000.00 BILL-PMT-712 advance + $16,500.00 INV-WMS-901 Year-1 SaaS).

Retains the full $17,850.00 unscheduled carryforward in 1350 without fabricating a 12-month amortization schedule or writing it off unsupported, decomposing it into $3,240.00 disclosed utility deposit (LEGACY-DEP-01) and $14,610.00 undisclosed prior-CPA migration lump sum (LEGACY-LUMP-02).

Applies snapshot-lineage carryforward rules to confirm DISC-1350-UTIL ($3,240.00 in close_disclosed_items) remains validly disclosed across snapshot bump 10447 -> 10555 because its account_activity_sha256 (9f4b2c81e0a3) is unchanged, whereas UNDISC-1350-LUMP ($14,610.00) lacks disclosure and triggers an unscheduled_balance close hold.

Reconciles total 1350 Prepaid Expenses & Vendor Advances from $128,850.00 unadjusted on October 31, 2026 ($44,850.00 opening + $84,000.00 October additions) to $86,850.00 audited ($69,000.00 scheduled + $17,850.00 unscheduled carryforward; -$42,000.00 net credit adjustment), alongside $23,333.33 net in 1370.
